persona_summary: Elena prefers calm, accessible Harbor UI screens with explicit labels instead of icon-only controls. Dense internal diagnostics may use compact tables. She later revokes the earlier preference for decorative gradients.
scenario: Suggest a layout for an internal Harbor UI diagnostics screen.

alternatives.content: The standing preference remains active, with a narrow exception for dense internal diagnostic views.

- Dense internal diagnostic views may use compact tables while preserving accessible labels.
- Use explicit text labels for important controls instead of icon-only actions.
In harbor-ui, give important controls explicit text labels rather than using icon-only actions. Dense internal diagnostic views may use compact tables, but must preserve accessible labels.
